title: 1736 Prairie's 18th Street side gains its three bay windows
items: Walk down 18th Street past the Ingraham/McBirney house: the side wall now carries the three canted bays the 1911 fire-insurance map draws — a timber bay window at the back, a brick bay rising two storeys in the middle, and a second timber bay near the front.
The front one was taken for a side porch before; the map draws it closed and canted, like the one at the back.

The house's record now dates itself: completed in 1864 for Granville S. Ingraham, with its mansard roof standing by about 1890 and still there in 1911 — possibly a later addition, which no source yet dates.
